stations.title: Noor
stations.say: Is all of PL-2041 on the shelf?

stations.title: Pip
stations.text: Asks for one lookup at a time.
stations.note: The order first, then each item.

stations.title: Your code
tasks: Stop a run with no end

captions: Noor wants to know if a whole order is on the shelf before a rider leaves.
That takes several lookups. Today Pip does one and stops halfway.
You write the loop that keeps going, in three tasks.
Now Pip looks up the order, then each item, until it can answer.
One question, as many lookups as it needs. And it always stops.
